summary: Aeon Acquisition I Corp. filed an 8-K reporting the effectiveness of its registration statement and the consummation of its IPO on June 4, 2026, of 12,500,000 units at a price not stated. Each unit consists of one Class A ordinary share, one warrant exercisable at $11.50, and one right to receive one-fourth of a share. Standard agreements (underwriting, trust, warrant, rights, letter, registration rights, private placement, indemnity) were entered. No special-situation event is present; this is a routine IPO completion filing for a blank-check company. No actionable special-situation is identified.
